name: Highlander Grogg Oat Milk Latte
caffeineNote: Torke's product page lists 220 mg in its spec list
summary: From Torke's own product page and not yet checked against a can: the Wisconsin roaster's Highlander Grogg flavor, with notes of caramel, butterscotch and vanilla, as a ready-to-drink latte on an oat milk base. Torke lists 220 mg of caffeine and 190 calories in an 11.75 oz can, and publishes no sugar, protein or ingredient list.
